scope: Local authoring tool, standalone game source and cross-language data checks; not a playable Unity scene or device acceptance.

checks: real local image decoded and sampled into hex targets
actual browser-downloaded JSON and witness replay
dense map export has no image field
canvas erase and undo update target data and invalidate export
paint edits one target cell, rebalances initial colors and revalidates
no browser console or page errors

consumer.scope: Standalone loader/BFS/atomic board commands; spare steps are an offline verification model, not a delivered runtime spare session.

contractParity: Schema and palette copies compared byte-for-byte to consumer; sample copy and task DAG verified. Used existing restricted schema keyword validator plus authoritative C# loader, not a general JSON Schema package.
limitations: Only the six existing shared sprite colors are exported; no white/cream palette extension.
Spare witness steps are an offline model; runtime spare/session/UI remain future tasks.
No Unity import/Test Runner/build/device or human visual acceptance.
QA input images/captures/downloads are ignored and not shipped or committed.
